name: STOP BURYING ME ALIVE, BEAUTIFUL!
source:
You wake up to your girlfriend burying you alive, and she won't be convinced that you aren't dead.

One of several problems, it turns out, as you find yourself dealing with rats trying to take a few early bites out of you! And just who is the girl talking to you from underground? 

[From [url=https://zephyo.itch.io/stop-burying-me-alive-beautiful]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒来时发现你的女朋友把你活埋了，她不会相信你没有死。

事实证明，这是几个问题之一，当你发现自己正在与老鼠打交道时，老鼠试图早早地咬你几口！那个在地下和你说话的女孩到底是谁？

[来自[url=https://zephyo.itch.io/stop-burying-me-alive-beautiful]itch.io[/url]]
